source.title: Infinity RPG — Nomads Faction Book
source.file: MUH050222 Infinity RPG - Nomads Faction Book.pdf

changes.factions: Kept current Nomad organisational selections; source-backed mothership homeworlds and heritage added. Uplift represented as separate Host / Heritage, not political faction.
changes.heritage: Added Bakunian, Corregidoran, Tunguskan, Lub’, Missionary, Vagrant and six source origin contexts.
changes.status: Nomad social status/class tables, home environments, 20 adolescent events, 19 faction career-table rows, Heritage career recommendations, 20 Career Events and 3 ‘Cat Squads.
changes.careers: 17 distinct Nomad source career names in main Career selector (plus General / Unrestricted for house-rule humans). Source career profiles added/updated, with existing cross-faction core profiles preserved.
changes.uplifts: 7 source species, 5 physical body/platform options, separate Species/Body controls and additive applicable attribute modifiers, 3 lab origins, source social status/awakening, 7 species career tables, 20 career events.
changes.equipment: 61 source-labelled Chapter 5 gear entries (56 new and 5 enriched existing names), source page/restriction/cost, no invented generic rarity. Corrected CrazyKoala Mine classification as explosive, preserving legacy weapon alias.
changes.socialEnergy: Optional Bakunin Social Energy Rank (SER) and inertia reference tables, faction groups, source access layers and mechanics in glossary. No compulsory extra track.
changes.legacy: Older Nomad characters with non-source homeworld/habitat labels preserve their original saved value during import, until player chooses a new source origin.
changes.embedded: Updated app.js/data.js and exact self-contained embedded scripts in index.html; site build metadata v71.
changes.regression: Preserved Ariadna Dogface/Wulver/Antipode, PanOceania Helot, Haqqislam and Yu Jing career filtering; custom Focus/skill inheritance, 5 weapons/10 equipment, Armour, and save compatibility.

explicitSourceExceptions: The printed Canine Uplift Career Table (p. 90) has overlapping ranges 8–15 and 12–13/14–15; the source ranges are preserved, and GM adjudication is needed.
The printed Feline Uplift Career Table (p. 90) omits d20 result 6; no result was invented.
The printed Nomad Faction Career Table lists Praxis Scientist twice, at results 12 and 15; both source outcomes are retained.
Uplift Medium Biomorph gives one player-chosen Attribute +1. This free choice is documented but not automatically assigned by the sheet.
Uplift Lhosts need a chosen specific Lhost template. The sheet does not fabricate a default Lhost attribute set.
Species-conditional Biomorph abilities remain source rules rather than automatically applied to Remote/Lhost bodies.
Nomad heritage career hazard reductions, source social class and Social Energy effects are described in Glossary rather than silently rewritten as custom Trait/Talent bonuses.
The main Nomad career table includes Reverend Agent as a Corebook career; no Nomad-book-only mechanical profile was invented.

checks: Nomad host list and 17 source career selection
Remote body does not apply biomorph modifiers
